scripts.verify: bun run verify:baseline && bun run test:contracts
scripts.verify:baseline: bun -e 'const child=Bun.spawn(["bun","run","--cwd","app","verify"],{stdout:"inherit",stderr:"inherit"});const code=await child.exited;const {rm}=await import("node:fs/promises");for(const path of ["app/dist","app/dist-e2e","app/test-results","app/playwright-report","output/playwright"]){await rm(path,{recursive:true,force:true});}process.exit(code);'
scripts.verify:v2: bun run verify && bun run test:server && bun run verify:ops && bun run typecheck && bun run lint
scripts.verify:release: bun run verify:v2 && bun test scripts/release/test/*.test.mjs && bun scripts/release/validate-release-config.mjs
scripts.verify:blueprint: bun run verify:studies && bun test scripts/completion/*.test.mjs && bun run verify:blueprint-status && bun run verify:ios-source && bun run verify:native-evidence
scripts.verify:ios-source: bun test scripts/ios/validate-ios-source.test.mjs scripts/ios/validate-ios-field-flow.test.mjs scripts/ios/validate-macos-handoff.test.mjs && bun scripts/ios/validate-ios-source.mjs && bun scripts/ios/validate-ios-field-flow.mjs
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd contracts typecheck && bun run --cwd app typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd app lint && bun run --cwd server lint
